purpose: Governance replay corpus (Addendum §A3.3). Each entry is a proposal Circuit assessed with a real committee on Studio Next; the expected label is what a careful human reviewer would say. The false-veto rate over benign entries is the deployability number. Two entries is a seed, not a benchmark — grow it with real DAO proposals (benign majority) and the known malicious ones (Tornado Cash governance takeover 2023-05, Term Labs 2026-08).
